title: Kelowna Group Parasailing Tour and Boat Ride
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Soar above the picturesque Okanagan Lake on a group parasailing tour in Kelowna. Experience a thrilling 10-minute flight where the stunning views of the lake and surrounding landscape create an unforgettable adventure. Enjoy the excitement of take-off and landing directly from the boat, ensuring a seamless experience for all participants. This tour is perfect for adventure seekers looking to take in the beauty of Kelowna from a unique vantage point.

- Group parasailing tour with breathtaking views over Okanagan Lake
- Enjoy a thrilling 10-minute flight with easy boat access
- Perfect for adventure seekers and family groups
- Experience the excitement of take-off and landing from the boat
